context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 68 verified Exploration Mode feature in SmartMap. Key findings: (1) Backend POST /api/ai/improve-location supports 6 types: what_to_see, where_to_eat, how_to_next (exploration) and less_queues, cheaper, best_time (optimization). (2) Frontend SmartMap popup shows 'Explorar:' section with 3 buttons and 'Otimizar:' section with 3 buttons when clicking on a location marker (numbered pins). (3) Special pins (airport/hotel) do NOT have exploration buttons - only location markers do. (4) All buttons have data-testid attributes: explore-what_to_see, explore-where_to_eat, explore-how_to_next, improve-less_queues, improve-cheaper, improve-best_time. (5) Clicking an explore button triggers the improve-location API and shows suggestions in an overlay with 'Aplicar ao roteiro' button. (6) SmartMap sidebar shows 'Referências' section with airport and hotel entries. Note: Rate limiting (5 requests/hour) may affect testing - use /api/ai/travel-plan/reset-limit to clear.
